name: window
prompt: A rustic swamp lodge window, front view, tall with a rounded arched top: a chunky weathered dark wooden frame with rough-hewn timber trim and a small carved keystone, wooden mullions dividing small glass panes that glow with warm golden candle light from inside, a thick wooden sill with green moss and a small trailing vine, two old wooden shutters slightly open on the sides, Louisiana bayou cabin style, flat back as if set into a wall.
